# Setup/Misc.

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Uncomment Librarys Required
library(tidyverse)
#library(readxl)
#library(readr)
#library(DBI)
#library(RSQLite)
#library(tidycensus)
#library(jsonlite)
#library(httr)
library(lubridate)
#library(rsample)
library(baguette)
library(dplyr)
library(GGally)
library(lubridate)
library(ranger)
library(readr)
library(rpart.plot)
library(skimr)
library(stringr)
library(tidymodels)

# Set seed for random data creation for replication
set.seed(123)

# Read in data
bike_data <- read_csv(
  "https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv", 
  locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

#check for missing Data
colSums(is.na(bike_data))

#general Summary Stats
summary(bike_data)

#DATA Clean up/Variable Renaming
bike_data <- mutate(bike_data,
    Date = dmy(Date),
    Seasons = factor(Seasons),
    Holiday = factor(Holiday),
    `Functioning Day` = factor(`Functioning Day`)
  ) |>
  rename(
    date = Date,
    bike_count = `Rented Bike Count`,
    hour = Hour,
    temp = `Temperature(°C)`,
    humidity = `Humidity(%)`,
    wind_speed = `Wind speed (m/s)`,
    visibility = `Visibility (10m)`,
    dew_point_temp = `Dew point temperature(°C)`,
    solar_radiation = `Solar Radiation (MJ/m2)`,
    rainfall = `Rainfall(mm)`,
    snowfall = `Snowfall (cm)`,
    seasons = Seasons,
    holiday = Holiday,
    functioning_day = `Functioning Day`
  )

#Summary statistics of Bike rentals grouped by Functioning Day
bike_data |>
  group_by(functioning_day) |>
  summarise(
    count_obs = n(),
    mean_rentals = mean(bike_count),
    stddev_rentals = sd(bike_count),
    median_rentals = median(bike_count),
    min_rentals = min(bike_count),
    max_rentals = max(bike_count)
  )

#create subsetted dataset
bike_yes <- subset(bike_data, functioning_day == "Yes")

#create sums of days by date, seasons, and holiday variables
bike_subset1 <- bike_yes |>
                  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) |>
                    summarise(sum_bkcnt = sum(bike_count),
                               sum_rf = sum(rainfall),
                               sum_sf = sum(snowfall),
                               mean_tmp = mean(temp),
                               mean_humid = mean(humidity),
                               mean_winds = mean(wind_speed),
                               mean_vis = mean(visibility),
                               mean_dptmp = mean(dew_point_temp),
                               mean_slrad = mean(solar_radiation),
                              .groups = "drop"
                               )

#Summary stats (removing Date as it makes sense to analyze this date per season/holiday based on our set up. Date will likely be best used to measure changes over time).
bike_subset1 |>
  group_by(seasons, holiday) |>
  summarise(
    count_obs = n(),
    mean_rentals = mean(sum_bkcnt),
    stddev_rentals = sd(sum_bkcnt),
    median_rentals = median(sum_bkcnt),
    min_rentals = min(sum_bkcnt),
    max_rentals = max(sum_bkcnt)
  )

```

## Task 1: Split the data

```{r}
#split data into 75/25 ratio
bike_split <- initial_split(
  bike_subset1,
  prop = 0.75,
  strata = seasons
)

#store splits as datasets
bike_train <- training(bike_split)
bike_test <- testing(bike_split)

#create 10 fold split of training data and fold
bike_fold <- vfold_cv(
  bike_train,
  v = 10,
  strata = seasons
)
```

## Task 2: Recipes

```{r}
#Recipe 1
recipe1 <- recipe(sum_bkcnt ~., data = bike_train) |>
            step_date(date, features = "dow", keep_original_cols = FALSE) |>
            step_mutate(
              day_type = factor(
                if_else(
                  day_type %in% c("Sat", "Sun"),
                  "Weekend", "Weekday"
                )
              )
            ) |>
            step_rm(day_type) |>
            step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
            step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

#Recipe 2
recipe2 <- recipe(sum_bkcnt ~ ., data = bike_train) |> 
            step_date(date, features = c("dow")) |>
            step_mutate(day_type = factor(ifelse(date_dow %in% 
                                                  c('Sat', 'Sun'), 
                                                 'weekend', 'weekday'))) |>
            step_rm(date, date_dow) |>
            step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
            step_dummy(seasons, holiday, dayType) |>
            step_interact(~starts_with('seasons'):starts_with('holiday') + 
                            starts_with('seasons'):mean_tmp + 
                            mean_tmp:sum_rf)

#Recipe3
recipe3 <- recipe(sum_bkcnt ~ ., data = bike_train) |> 
                    step_date(date, features = c("dow")) |>
                    step_mutate(dayType = factor(ifelse(date_dow %in% 
                                                          c('Sat', 'Sun'),
                                                        'weekend', 'weekday'))) |>
                    step_rm(date, date_dow) |>
                    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
                    step_dummy(seasons, holiday, dayType) |>
                    step_interact(~starts_with('seasons'):starts_with('holiday') + 
                                    starts_with('seasons'):mean_tmp +
                                    temperatureC:sum_rf) |>
                    step_poly(mean_tmp,mean_humid)
```
